name: case
optionsCaseDescription: The number of the moderation case.
optionsReasonDescription: The new reason for the moderation case.
optionsDurationDescription: The new duration for the moderation case.
optionsUserDescription: The user to filter the moderation cases by.
optionsOverviewDescription: Whether or not to show the overview of the moderation cases.
optionsShowDescription: Whether or not to show the response publicly.
timeNotAllowed: The type of the moderation case (**{{type}}**) does not allow for a duration.
timeNotAllowedInCompletedEntries: The moderation case `{{caseId}}` has already been completed and cannot be edited.
timeEditNotSupported: The type of the moderation case (**{{type}}**) does not allow editing the duration.
timeTooEarly: The duration of the moderation case would end before it starts ({{time}}). The duration starts at {{start}}.
listEmpty: There are no moderation cases with the selected filters.
deletePrompt: Delete case **{{caseId}}**? A deleted case cannot be brought back.
menuWrongUser: This menu is not for you, run the command to open your own.
editDurationDescription: A new duration such as 2d, or 0 to remove it. Leave it empty to keep the one the case has.
editStaffNoteDescription: Only the moderators read it. The user is never told.
editProofDescription: An image or a video up to 10 MB. It takes the place of the proof the case has.
editUnchanged: Case **{{caseId}}** already was as you wrote it, nothing was changed.
notifyUndelivered: I could not send the direct message to the user.
proofNoChannel: I could not keep the proof: set the moderation log channel first, the file is kept there.
proofTooLarge: I could not keep the proof: the file is larger than 10 MB.
proofInvalidType: I could not keep the proof: the file is neither an image nor a video.
proofFailed: I could not keep the proof: the file could not be sent to the moderation log.
historyEmpty: No edit history found for case **{{caseId}}**.
